title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Paris grid point, race Sundays 2017–2026
claims: The API returned grid point 48.89279 N / 2.29202 E at 36 m elevation; for the eight available race Sundays 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, daily maximum temperature ranged from 7.9 C to 23.4 C with a median of 14.0 C.
Daily minimum temperature ranged from -2.0 C to 12.1 C with a median of 5.8 C.
Two of the eight race Sundays recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation (2024: 13.2 mm; 2025: 1.7 mm); the others were dry or under 1 mm.
On 12 April 2026 the grid point recorded a maximum of 14.0 C, a minimum of 5.8 C and 0.2 mm precipitation.

The 2020 edition was cancelled and the 2021 edition was held in October, so neither April Sunday is included in this series; values are modelled reanalysis data for a grid point, not measurements taken on the course.

verification.checkedVia: curl.exe 请求 archive-api.open-meteo.com 保存 paris-weather.json；Node 按历届比赛日日期取 max/min/precip 并排序取中位

claimVerification.note: 2020 取消；2021 于 10 月 17 日举行；模型再分析网格值，非赛道实测。
